label: 🔧 dbt
description: Read a dbt model as a DIG dataset. Parses the dbt project's manifest.json and resolves the model's compiled SQL or its materialized table. The visual layer that completes dbt — exploration, ML feature derivation, scheduled custom outputs, all on top of your trusted dbt models.

project_path.label: dbt project directory
project_path.help: Absolute path to the dbt project root (the folder containing dbt_project.yml). DIG reads target/manifest.json from this directory.

model.label: Model name
model.help: Bare model name (e.g. dim_customers) or fully-qualified (my_marts.dim_customers).

target.label: dbt target
target.help: Which target from profiles.yml to read against. Defaults to 'dev'.
